t: A defensive pact of three Alpine valleys in 1291 grew into a league of thirteen cantons by 1513.
Swiss pikemen defeated Habsburg and Burgundian armies and served as Europe's most sought-after mercenaries.
Without a central government, it relied on a consensus Diet; French invasion in 1798 replaced it with the Helvetic Republic.
dyk: The Federal Charter of 1291 became the official founding document only in the 1890s, when 1 August was chosen as the Swiss national day.
ev: Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden conclude the Federal Charter
The Confederates defeat a Habsburg army at the Battle of Morgarten
Duke Leopold III of Austria is killed at the Battle of Sempach
Charles the Bold of Burgundy is defeated at Grandson and Murten
Defeat by Francis I at Marignano ends Swiss great-power ambitions
Zwingli is killed in the Second Kappel War
The Peace of Westphalia recognises Swiss independence from the Empire
French invasion ends the Confederacy; the Helvetic Republic is proclaimed

f.capital: None; the Diet met mostly at Baden and later Frauenfeld
